description: Read-only fetch of one exact section or record by dotted path. Sections: organization, people, services, industries, frameworks, research, externalAssets, answers, blogs. Use when you know the path from search/list; use nebula_overview for a summary, nebula_search to find paths, nebula_list to browse titles. Returns path plus value, or for list sections: items, total, offset, limit, nextOffset. Examples: "services", "answers.4", "organization.address".

limit.description: For list sections: items per page (default 20)

offset.description: For list sections: first item index (default 0)

name: nebula_section
title: Read a Nebula section
